)

FROM pickup_slot AS s CROSS JOIN packing AS p CROSS JOIN hoist AS h

), totals AS (

  FROM pulse_option AS p

  GROUP BY p.depart_min, p.seat_limit, p.source_id

WITH shortfalls AS (
  SELECT catalog_id, pay_rank, earned_cents, MAX(floor_cents - earned_cents, 0) AS shortfall
  FROM guarantee_terms
), queued AS (
  SELECT s.*, COALESCE(SUM(shortfall) OVER (ORDER BY pay_rank, catalog_id COLLATE BINARY ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prior_shortfall
  FROM shortfalls AS s
), funded AS (
  SELECT q.*, MIN(shortfall, MAX(r.reserve_cents - prior_shortfall, 0)) AS topup_cents
  FROM queued AS q
  CROSS JOIN monthly_reserves AS r
  WHERE r.month_key = '2026-04'
)
SELECT catalog_id, topup_cents, earned_cents + topup_cents AS payable_cents, shortfall - topup_cents AS unmet_cents
FROM funded
ORDER BY pay_rank, catalog_id COLLATE BINARY
